sentences.en: As for me, I will not approve of the plan.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我不会赞成这个计划。

sentences.en: He nodded to show that he approved of my plan.
sentences.zh: 他点了点头表示赞同我的计划。

sentences.en: I can't approve of your going out with him.
sentences.zh: 我不能同意你和他出去。

senses.zh: 赞成，同意vt.批准,认可,核准,为…提供证据vi.赞同,称许,称赞,满意、喜欢(of)

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ap（加强）+prov（证明）+ e→证明可行→赞成
